question: C, O, U, N, T, and Y live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on, till the topmost floor is numbered 6. Only two people live above C. Only two people live between C and T. Only N lives between C and U. Y lives immediately below C. Who lives on the floor, numbered 2?
